mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the past month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 6.5% in the past month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 6.5.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 1% in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), the central bank's policy shift to combat inflation leads to higher discount rates and reduced equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production signals weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days, regardless of regime.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines by at least 0.5% in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 750,000 units, it signals a collapse in the housing market and reduced consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 750.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous slowdown in payroll employment growth (PAYEMS growth rate < 0.1%) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE > 6.0%) signals a deepening labor market crisis, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth rate < 0.1% and UNRATE > 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply contraction (INDPRO declining for 3 consecutive months), the reduction in economic output leads to higher inflation and reduced corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines for 3 consecutive months.
